info.title: openskycam API
info.description: Read original footage from the existing camera archive. Create a key in the website under API access, then send Authorization: Bearer <key>. Pagination, checksums, and byte-range downloads support large transfers. Raw footage expires under the existing 40-day retention policy. Everything the website does is also an API call: each /api/<path> operation except API key management is served at /v1/<path> for an Agent key that covers every camera, under the same name (the website copy is website_<name>), and image links in its answers point at /v1. API key management requires a website session and cannot be used with a Bearer key. Processor endpoints are an opt-in local integration preview. They require a processor:run credential restricted to one registered pipeline and selected cameras. Continuous production inference is not enabled. Model publishing uses models:write; device synchronization uses models:sync scoped to one device. Models persist independently of footage retention. Workshop saves logical buckets and workflows, runs explicitly submitted bounded labeling jobs, and freezes reviewed dataset versions. Workshop execution uses workshop:run keys scoped to a device and cameras. Existing footage:read keys can download dataset manifests and images for their cameras. This does not enable continuous production inference.

get.summary: Find recordings by camera and time
get.description: Returns original recordings overlapping [from, to), ordered by start and object key. Unknown durations use a 60-second overlap estimate. Follow next_url until null; send the same Bearer header on every request. New uploads after as_of are excluded from subsequent pages. Retention may still remove older objects during a transfer. Files are not trimmed or transcoded. Responses contain download URLs, sizes, and checksums; no dataset is created.

get.description: Streams original MP4 bytes without buffering or transcoding. A single Range header enables resumable downloads. Send the Bearer key on every request; a listed download_url does not grant access by itself. The one exception is a signed link (query parameters key, expires and sig, valid for one hour, GET or HEAD of that exact path only) that an agent key's MCP tools hand out; it needs no header and stops working when its key is revoked or rotated. Cache files locally by object key and SHA-256. Raw footage follows the 40-day retention policy.

delete.description: Permanently removes a labeled bucket, its image/label memberships (including saved items), and dataset versions. Clears its input/output selections in linked workflows and cancels unfinished runs referencing it. Preserves source footage, other bucket memberships, and shared image bytes. Unreferenced retained copies become eligible for cleanup after a one-hour grace period. Camera archive cannot be deleted. Requires a signed-in website session and same-origin request. The confirmed document revision is enforced atomically; stale confirmations return 409 without modifying data.

get.description: Returns a 256px or 512px JPEG, optionally cropped around the highest-confidence box. Original bytes are unchanged. Each thumbnail is made once and kept until its image expires or its labels change, so later reads from any browser return the kept copy. Authenticated, private browser cache for at most one day and no longer than image expiry; ETag supports revalidation. Signed-in website session required.
